core: Triglyceride storage and lipid droplet turnover
qualifier: adipocyte, with glycerol-3-phosphate and fructose metabolism
name: Adipocyte triglyceride storage, lipolysis and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover triglyceride/DAG/PA synthesis, lipolysis, lipid droplet formation, lipophagy and adipogenesis, and unlike the phospholipid-remodeling and thermogenic/insulin confusables they add glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and fructose metabolism.

qualifier: autocrine/paracrine signaling and SIRP interactions
name: M-CSF signaling with autocrine, paracrine and SIRP interactions
rationale: Members center on CSF1/M-CSF and interleukin receptor signaling regulating macrophage proliferation; autocrine/paracrine signaling, receptor-binding inhibition and SIRP family interactions separate it from IL-6, myeloid differentiation and DAP12 neighbours.

qualifier: restraint of meiosis I phase transitions
name: Meiotic checkpoint control of meiosis I phase transitions
rationale: All members regulate (mostly negatively) meiotic phase transitions, G2/MI entry and chromosome separation, whereas confusables concern chiasma, cohesion, chromosome alignment and oocyte spindle mechanics.

qualifier: monoaminergic and sensory (DRG) neurons, anterior/posterior
name: Repulsive axon guidance of monoaminergic and sensory neurons
rationale: Members concern chemorepulsion and inhibition of axon extension along the anterior/posterior axis for dopaminergic, serotonergic and dorsal root ganglion neurons, unlike confusables centered on netrin/Sema3A effectors, sprouting or commissural midline guidance.

qualifier: retinoic acid, BMP and PAX3 developmental regulators
name: Differentiation-coupled quiescence with retinoic acid, BMP and PAX3 regulators
rationale: Members link G0 entry/exit, FOXO and p75NTR cell-cycle arrest and BMP cytostatic modules to retinoic acid/estrogen receptor regulation and PAX3 targets, a developmental growth-arrest context absent from the p53, thyroid hormone and ALK transcription confusables.

core: Tricarboxylic acid cycle and pyruvate oxidation
qualifier: coenzyme A synthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly
name: TCA cycle with pyruvate oxidation and coenzyme A synthesis
rationale: Members span PDH-mediated pyruvate oxidation, TCA intermediates, succinate dehydrogenase and Fe-S cluster assembly plus CoA/pantothenate synthesis, distinguishing it from lipoylation/OGDH neighbours and the malate-aspartate shuttle/transport theme.

core: Cellular response to oxidative and hypoxic stress
qualifier: hydrogen peroxide-triggered intrinsic apoptosis, nitrosative and ischemic stress
name: Peroxide, nitrosative and ischemic stress responses with apoptosis
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, hypoxia/ischemia, nitrosative stress and H2S with regulation of the resulting intrinsic apoptosis, unlike confusables centered on ferroptosis, respiration control or nitric oxide sensing.

qualifier: TRIF/TLR3 and RIPK1 necroptotic signaling
name: Caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis and TRIF/RIPK1 necroptosis
rationale: Members cover FAS/TRAIL-driven procaspase-8 activation, c-FLIP and BID, plus TLR3/TRIF- and RIPK1-mediated necroptosis, which separates it from T-cell activation-induced death and TBK1/IRF3 confusables.

qualifier: BH4 cofactor supply and MAO/COMT catabolism
name: Monoamine synthesis and MAO/COMT degradation with BH4 cofactor
rationale: Members cover catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis, MAO and COMT degradation and tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis, whereas confusables concern monoamine transport/release or amino-acid neurotransmitter transport.

qualifier: atypical RHOBTB, Ral and rhotekin/rhophilin signaling
name: GTPase activity control via atypical RHOBTB and Ral GTPases
rationale: Most members concern GTPase activation/inhibition and RHOBTB, Ral and Rho-rhotekin cycles, distinguishing it from Rab/Arf, Golgi-organization and protein-localization neighbours; diphtheria toxin and surface localization members are peripheral.

core: Magnesium homeostasis and cellular energy buffering
qualifier: mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange, creatine and inositol metabolism
name: Magnesium homeostasis, ATP/ADP exchange and creatine-inositol metabolism
rationale: Members combine magnesium transport/homeostasis with mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange, phosphocreatine and inositol metabolism/transport, which the ion-transport and protein-oligomerization confusables lack; calcium-independent adhesion is an outlier.

qualifier: STRA6, LRAT and RDH12 loss of function
name: Retinoid metabolism disease from STRA6, LRAT, RDH12 loss
rationale: Members are vitamin A metabolism and its disease events caused by STRA6, LRAT and RDH12 defects, unlike confusables on the rod/cone retinoid cycle (ABCA4, RDH5) or retinoic acid synthesis.

qualifier: brain ventricle development and CSF circulation
name: Ependymal multiciliogenesis and brain ventricle CSF circulation
rationale: Members span transcriptional control of multiciliogenesis, de novo centriole and basal body assembly, ventricle development and CSF flow, whereas confusables concern centrosome/cilium assembly, dynein arms and left-right asymmetry.

qualifier: triggered by ligand absence in neurons
name: Neuronal apoptosis via dependence receptors in absence of ligand
rationale: Members concern caspase activation by unliganded dependence receptors (NTRK3), NRAGE-JNK death signaling and neuronal apoptosis control, unlike confusables on p75NTR-neurotrophin binding, FOXO death genes or anoikis.

core: Inhibitory synapse assembly and postsynaptic potential regulation
qualifier: gephyrin and GABA receptor clustering
name: Gephyrin-GABA receptor inhibitory synapse assembly and postsynaptic potentials
rationale: Members cover gephyrin/GABA receptor clustering, inhibitory synapse assembly and regulation of IPSPs/EPSPs, unlike confusables on excitatory PSD-95/NMDA clustering, synaptic adhesion or presynaptic release.

core: Transcription initiation, elongation and termination by RNA polymerases I-III
qualifier: Pol II promoter escape and HIV Tat-driven elongation
name: RNA polymerase I-III transcription cycle and HIV Tat elongation
rationale: Members span Pol I rRNA, Pol II mRNA and Pol III tRNA/5S/snRNA transcription steps plus HIV Tat-mediated elongation and MYC targets, whereas confusables concern RNA processing, splicing, decay and ribosome assembly.

qualifier: midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation and monoaminergic axon guidance
name: Spinal motor neuron and midbrain dopaminergic neuron specification
rationale: Members cover spinal cord patterning, motor neuron and interneuron fate, and midbrain dopaminergic differentiation with monoaminergic axon guidance, the midbrain part being absent from floor-plate and hindbrain confusables.

qualifier: HDL and LDL
name: HDL and LDL particle remodeling
rationale: All four members are remodeling of HDL and LDL particles, whereas confusables concern assembly, remodeling and clearance of triglyceride-rich chylomicrons and VLDL.

core: Pyruvate oxidation and TCA cycle metabolism
qualifier: carboxylate transmembrane transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
name: Pyruvate-TCA metabolism with carboxylate transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: Members span PDH, CoA synthesis and TCA intermediates together with pyruvate/di- and tricarboxylate SLC transport and the malate-aspartate shuttle, which the glutamate/nitrogen and Fe-S/electron-transport confusables lack.

qualifier: AMPA receptor regulation and diffusion trapping
name: AMPA receptor trapping in excitatory short-term plasticity
rationale: Members concern excitatory transmission, AMPA receptor activity and diffusion trapping, and short-term plasticity, unlike confusables on kainate receptors, GABA/GIRK presynaptic inhibition.

qualifier: ICOS/Tfh help for germinal center B cell differentiation
name: Lymphocyte activation with ICOS-Tfh germinal center B help
rationale: Members cover T and B cell development/activation, ICOS costimulation, Tfh differentiation and germinal center B differentiation, distinguishing it from B-cell signature, BCR signaling, TCR/CD28 and thymic selection confusables.

qualifier: ribonucleoside and guanine
name: Purine ribonucleoside and guanine salvage
rationale: All members concern salvage of purine ribonucleosides and guanine, unlike confusables on deoxyribonucleoside defects, purine catabolism or HPRT nucleobase/IMP salvage.

core: Adrenal steroidogenesis and its CYP enzyme defects
qualifier: aldosterone/mineralocorticoid synthesis and secretion
name: Adrenal aldosterone, cortisol and androgen synthesis and CYP defects
rationale: Members cover mineralocorticoid, glucocorticoid and androgen biosynthesis and their CYP11/17/19/21 deficiencies, with aldosterone synthesis and secretion distinguishing it from estrogen/progesterone and pregnenolone confusables.

qualifier: laminin/dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular junction assembly
name: Skeletal muscle basement membrane, dystroglycan complex and NMJ assembly
rationale: Members cover laminin interactions, basement membrane assembly, DGC formation, NMJ/AChR clustering and myogenesis, separating it from DAG1 glycosylation, collagen anchoring and contractile-apparatus confusables.

qualifier: late sterol (Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell) steps and oxysterol-route bile acids
name: Late cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol-route bile acid formation
rationale: Members span post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis via desmosterol/lathosterol and bile acid synthesis via 24- and 27-hydroxycholesterol with linked SPG/CTX defects, unlike confusables on mevalonate steps, 7alpha-hydroxylation or fatty acid oxidation.
